name: Better Colony Commands
description: Anti-grief protection, admin and player commands, windows (UI) for all commands, economy and an API for other mods.
author: Kleator (originally Adrenalynn, Xell)
longdescription: Anti-grief protection for spawn, banners and custom areas, jail, war, roleplay, announcements, chat colors, activity tracking, teleport and travel commands.

Since 1.1.0: every command in a window (/help), output windows with paging, admin configuration (/bcconfig), permission overview (/permissions), /modlist, /roletime, /roles, /rtp and an economy (/money, /pay, /baltop) that works together with Pytonia Automation and THE TRADER.
Other mods can register commands, permissions and use the economy through ColonyCommands.BccApi.

notes: new: /help opens a command window (only commands you may use) with filter, paging, details and execute with parameter fields - permissions are re-checked on the server for every click

new: output of info commands (/top, /online, /roles, /roletime, ...) in windows with paging and a back button; players exclude commands with /bcui or /bcsettings, the server list Ui.ExcludedCommands always wins

new: /roletime, /roles, /rtp (random teleport with server-side range and cooldown), /modlist (preview image, version, description, detail page), /permissions (all permissions in the game, mod, who has them, unused ones - admins only), /bcconfig (admin configuration window)

new: economy module based on Pytonia Automation's (/money, /pay, /baltop, /exchange, /addmoney, /removemoney, /setmoney), mirrored and three-way merged with Pytonia Automation, THE TRADER coins converted into money if that mod is removed - no data loss

new: ColonyCommands.BccApi for other mods (commands with description/usage/parameters, permissions, economy, output windows); commands of other mods are discovered automatically and listed in /help; commands without permission get an auto-created one that is open to everyone until assigned
/warpbanner and every colony lookup ignore formatting and symbols (Highrise-City3 finds a fully formatted banner name)
roles shown with their chatcolors.json formatting everywhere; <size> removed from player-defined names in chat and UI
fixed antigrief-config.example.json key "ShowJoinPopup " (trailing space)
role management window: roles as tree with multi-level inheritance, create/rename/delete roles (renamed everywhere), formatting and permissions per role
home points (/sethome, /home, /homes, /delhome + window) are now part of Better Colony Commands with limits per role; homes, limits and home permissions of Pytonia Automation are imported
test a role for 2 minutes (button per role, /roletest): your roles come back automatically - also after a disconnect, a server stop or a crash
permission groups are backed up; if a game update resets permissiongroups.json, the last state is restored automatically
trust on claims: 'Manage Permission' next to 'Manage Owners' in the Colony tab and /trust - let friends build on one or all of your claims, Angry Guards friend toggle
role pages and player pages know every player's roles like the chat tag does (default role also when the game only copied it, roles through higher roles); no more duplicate roles
declared compatibility with Colony Survival 0.18.0.10 (built and tested against it)
/achievements: are Steam achievements still on for you and this world - admins switch them back on with /achievements enable {player|all}
commands of mods without a command list (e.g. MapMod's /map) are listed in /help too
new option ShowJoinChatMessage: switch off the 'Anti-Grief protection enabled' chat line for everyone
colonists/job blocks in protected areas: one game notification per session instead of chat spam
window title, margins and row colors fixed; /help and /modlist scroll on one page; mod list sorted by last update (or A-Z) with full version history
/warpbanner without name works for all your colonies again; /bannername shows last seen; role spacing; /baltop with roles
the game's own commands listed in /help with their real permissions; announcements window in /bcconfig
player moderation window (/players): all players by last online, ban/jail/mute status, incidents, money, roles, permissions, colonies, colony limit, homes, moderation history with notes
role pages list their players (add/remove); new defaults: window width 1000, chat format {name}{rolename:top}{rp}: {message}

fixed row buttons (role Edit/Remove, home Teleport/Delete); /rtp with ground correction and parachute; window executions logged with result; logo under the window title; paging only beyond 500 lines; clearer headings

fixed implausibly high /top time and /mtop time values (e.g. thousands of hours) for some players - a player is added to the game's connected-players list (picked up by the autosave/disconnect playtime tracking) before this mod's activity tracker resets their session start time, so a connection that dropped mid-load, or an autosave landing in that gap, could credit them with the entire time since their previous session as 'played'

now resets the session start time as early as possible (OnPlayerConnectedEarly), and any single tracked gap over 24 hours is discarded instead of added to playtime, as a safety net against stale timestamps

{rolename:top}/{rolename:bottom}/{rolename:} no longer auto-wrap a group's prefix in [brackets] - a prefix like "[Owner]" was being double-bracketed to "[[Owner]]"; brackets are now entirely up to the prefix value itself, so include them there (e.g. "[God]") if wanted
updated chatcolors.example.json's prefixes to include their own brackets to match

fixed chatcolors.json's Format being silently ignored (reset to the default) if it was added to an existing flat file without also wrapping the per-group entries in a "Groups" key - Format is now recognized on its own, and every other top-level key is treated as a group automatically when no explicit "Groups" wrapper is present

fixed /ban by nickname failing for offline players ('player not found') - the name lookup wasn't told to include offline players, so only banning by raw SteamID64 worked while a player was disconnected. Banning by SteamID already worked regardless of online status; nickname lookup now does too.

fixed unquoted multi-word player names (e.g. '/groups Aldric Stormvale') being cut off at the first space and failing with 'player not found' - the 1.0.12 fix only helped once a name reached PlayerHelper, but the command's own regex was already truncating it before that; fixed for /groups, /kick, /list, /lastseen, /killplayer, /killnpcs, /unmute, /tpa, /antigrief always, and for /ban, /mute, /rpban, /jail when a numeric time value is given to anchor on

fixed ColonyNameGuard never re-checking a colony's current name against the blacklist if the name hadn't changed since it was last accepted - meant a colony that already existed before a word was added to blacklistedwords.json (or before /bcreload) stayed unflagged forever instead of being corrected on the next scan

player name matching (used by every command that takes a playername argument) now ignores whitespace differences as a fallback, so a splitscreen profile like 'PlayerName 1' can be targeted by typing it as one word 'PlayerName1' without needing quotes, and doesn't get confused with the main account of the same name
this also tolerates minor extra/missing spacing anywhere in a typed player name
added /bcreload to reload config files (antigrief-config.json, chatcolors.json, travelpaths.json, blacklistedwords.json, jail-config.json, announcements.json) without a server restart
deliberately excludes runtime/history data (playeractivity.json, ban logs, jail log, roleplay bans, war status) and never re-triggers a startup-only background loop a second time

fixed ColonyNameGuard silently and permanently keeping a blacklisted colony name if the fallback '{OwnerName}'s Colony' rename was itself still blacklisted (e.g. a blacklisted word in the player's own name) - it now falls back to a generic 'Colony {id}' name in that case instead
expanded blacklistedwords.example.json to 75 entries (English coverage nearly doubled) and hardened every pattern against letter-stretching and fuller leetspeak substitution
fixed /setcolonyname, /groups, /tpa, /tpaccept and /tpadeny not being recognized - they were never added to the mod's command registration list
renamed blacklistednames.json to blacklistedwords.json

blacklistedwords.json entries are now regex patterns instead of plain substrings (a plain word still works unchanged); blacklistedwords.example.json ships with a starter list covering common profanity/slurs in English, German, French and Spanish
every automatic colony name correction now logs a console warning naming the rejected name, the corrected name, and the exact blacklistedwords.json rule that matched
admins can rename any colony with /setcolonyname (closest banner, any owner)
optional blacklistednames.json reverts colony names created or renamed to something blacklisted
added /tpa, /tpaccept, /tpadeny teleport requests with an accept countdown and request timeout
added /groups {playername} to list a player's assigned permission groups
chatcolors.json now controls the full chat line layout via a Format template ({name}, {rolename:top/bottom/<group>}, {role:<group>;string:"..."}, {rp}, {message}), old-style files still load
player names shown by other mod commands (top, mtop, online, jail, ban, kick, whisper, trade, war, roleplay ban, etc.) now use the same chat-color formatting as the live chat line
fixed jail's restoreGroupsOnRelease actually restoring a player's prior permission group(s) - it silently never worked before, always falling back to defaultGroup
added jail-config.json rolesGrantedOnJail/rolesGrantedOnRelease to grant extra groups while jailed or after release
maintenance taken over by Kleator from this version onward - credit to Xell for maintaining the mod through version 1.0.6, and to Adrenalynn as the original developer
fixed players losing their lastSeen/playtime history in playeractivity.json after reconnecting, caused by game version 0.18.0.0 adding a splitscreen 'profile' field to player IDs
existing playeractivity.json entries are now migrated automatically to the new '<id> (<steamid>, profile <n>)' key format on world load
fixed quarter block placement regression caused by the transport compatibility hook reserving non-transport clicks too early

added an anti-grief join popup so players can see the notice even when the chat stays collapsed
made the join popup configurable via ShowJoinPopup in antigrief-config.json
skip the anti-grief join notice entirely when protection and punishments are fully disabled
pushed the anti-grief join message later to avoid the local client chatbox race
fixed local world startup by creating default anti-grief config without relying on backup folders
moved the transport compatibility hook into the main callback manager and added targeted transport logging
delayed the anti-grief join message to avoid an early local client chat crash
added a transport compatibility fallback for rail, elevator and glider clicks on 0.15.1.0
kept the anti-grief join callback active and verified in current logs
rebuilt against Colony Survival 0.15.1.0
